model_column_mapping: Current features.py drops unused native bit 0: model column 0 maps to MACCS key 1 and model column 165 maps to key 166.

notation.heteroatom_Q: Any atom other than C or H, except when exactSMARTS specifies differently.
notation.tilde: Any bond; do not silently relabel it a single bond.
notation.count: RDKit match-count threshold, not necessarily disjoint chemical fragments.
notation.aromaticity: RDKit aromaticity and ring perception apply.

special_keys.1: RDKit isotope key is undefined and unset.
special_keys.125: More than one all-aromatic bond ring, evaluated algorithmically; no single SMARTS.
special_keys.166: More than one disconnected molecular fragment, evaluated algorithmically; no single SMARTS.

limits: Some original source comments mark specifications as incomplete. The exact installed RDKit implementation remains authoritative.
Human labels are explanatory shorthand. Keep exact SMARTS, match-count thresholds and algorithmic definitions in accompanying source tables.
Select and rank features using the actual current explanation source; no historical ranking or chemical-label assignment is encoded here.
MACCS pattern associations are model explanations, not independent toxic fragments or causal mechanisms.
